review.posthog_relevance: Adds cache age parameter to the alert evaluation execution path, allowing the dispatcher to pass a computed cache age to extractors and detectors, which use it to decide whether to reuse cached results.
review.reason: The change adds cache age calculation and its use in the alert evaluation execution path. P1.F1.H3 adds the cache age parameter to the extraction protocol, P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 add it to the detector extraction and calculation functions. This supports caching behavior in the alert evaluation backend. P1.F8 and P1.F10 are test-only and do not contribute to production implementation
